_comment: The release this site claims to describe. The documentation itself is no longer rendered here -- it is built from the core repository with MkDocs and published per version at /dims/<version>/ -- but the hand-written pages still make claims about a release (install commands, release-tag links) and tools/check_unpinned_pages.py settles them against this ref. tools/sync_tokens.py vendors the palette from the same ref.
